headline: Conditional use and site plan requests for 10 North Southwood Drive, 4 Beard Street, 181 East Hollis Street, and L Daniel Webster Highway.
summary: The Planning Board will consider conditional use permits and site plans for several properties, including a vehicle repair facility, a multifamily building extension, a 48-unit multifamily building, and a 48,000-square-foot flex building. The board will also review the tentative agenda for developments of regional impact and may enter a nonpublic session on pending litigation.
items: Conditional Use Permit request for a vehicle repair and service facility at 10 North Southwood Drive (A26-0187)
1-year extension of Conditional Use Permit for a 3-story, 9-unit multi-family building at 4 Beard Street (A26-0204)
Site plan approval for a 48-unit multifamily building at 181 East Hollis Street (A26-0155) - postponed to this meeting by Applicant request
1-year extension of site plan approval for a 3-story, 9-unit multi-family building at 4 Beard Street (A26-0188)
Site plan approval for a 48,000-sqft flex building at L Daniel Webster Highway, Innovative Way Extension (A26-0198)
Review of tentative agenda to determine developments of regional impact
Possible motion to enter Nonpublic Session under RSA 91-A:3, II (e) regarding pending or threatened litigation
location: Nashua City Hall, 229 Main Street, Nashua, NH

AMENDED AGENDA 
 
To: NCPB Members 
 
From: Planning Staff 
 
Re: Regular Meeting and Public Hearing October 15, 2026 
 
Notice is hereby given that a Public Hearing of the City of Nashua Planning Board will occur on Thursday, 
October 15, 2026 at 7:00 PM at the Nashua City Hall located at 229 Main Street, Nashua, NH. The public may 
submit their comments in advance of the meeting via email pb@nashuanh.gov or by mail (please make sure 
to include your name/address and comments) by 4PM on October 14, 2026. Letters should be addressed to 
City of Nashua, Planning Department, P.O. Box 2019, Nashua, NH 03061. Plans can be viewed online starting 
October 12, 2026 at  https://nashuanh.portal.civicclerk.com/. The public may request access via Zoom; contact 
the Planning Department before 4PM on October 14, 2026, for a link. 
 
A. Call to Order 
B. Roll Call 
C. Approval of Minutes – October 1, 2026 
D. Communications 
E. Report of Chairman, Committee, & Liaison

NONPUBLIC SESSION 
The Planning Board will need to make a motion to enter into a Nonpublic Session under RSA 91-A:3, II (e)
